prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1330; do not mention it.)
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred in a parking lot on [LOSS_DATE]. Our investigation shows that your insured backed out of a parking space without yielding to my client's vehicle, which was lawfully traveling through the lane. The impact caused my client's car to sustain significant damage and resulted in immediate neck pain and stiffness.

Following the collision, my client sought medical evaluation and was diagnosed with a cervical neck strain. Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed medication, and ongoing restrictions on work and daily activities. My client continues to experience pain and limited range of motion, and the treating providers have indicated that recovery will take additional time.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to keep a proper lookout and failed to yield the right of way, and the resulting injuries and losses are the direct consequence of that negligence.

To resolve this claim without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], which reflects medical expenses, lost wages, and general damages. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. Please direct all future correspondence regarding this claim to my office.

Sincerely,

Attorney for [CLIENT_NAME]
